taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name is a header field on Schedule E but does not correspond to any leaf element in the IRS MeF schema for IRS1040ScheduleE; it is carried at the parent 1040 level.

taxpayer_ssn.rationale: Taxpayer SSN is a header field on Schedule E but is not represented as a leaf element in the IRS1040ScheduleE schema; it resides at the parent 1040 level.

tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a form-header attribute not represented as a leaf element within the IRS1040ScheduleE schema.

part_i_properties.rationale: The array of Part I rental/royalty properties maps to the repeating PropertyRealEstAndRoyaltyGroup container; blueprint should decompose each array entry into the individual child elements of that group.

part_i_total_rents_received.rationale: TotAllPaymentsAllRentalPropAmt holds the total rents received across all Part I properties (line 23a totals).

part_i_total_royalties_received.rationale: TotAllPaymentsAllRyltyPropAmt holds the total royalties received across all Part I properties (line 23b totals).

part_i_total_expenses.rationale: TotalAllPropTotalExpensesAmt holds the total expenses across all Part I properties (line 23c totals).

part_i_net_income_or_loss.rationale: TotalIncomeOrLossAmt is the net income/loss summary element that aggregates Part I results carried forward; line 26 equivalent in the schema.

part_ii_entries.rationale: The array of Part II partnership/S-corp rows maps to the repeating PartnershipOrSCorpGroup container; blueprint should decompose each array entry into the individual child elements of that group.

part_ii_total_passive_income.rationale: TotalPassiveIncomeAmt holds the total passive income from all Part II entities.

part_ii_total_passive_loss.rationale: TotalPassiveLossAllowedAmt holds the total passive loss allowed from all Part II entities.

part_ii_total_nonpassive_income.rationale: BusTotalNonpassiveIncomeAmt holds the total nonpassive income from all Part II entities.

part_ii_total_nonpassive_loss.rationale: TotalNonpassiveLossAmt holds the total nonpassive loss from all Part II entities.

part_ii_net_income_or_loss.rationale: NetPrtshpSCorpIncomeOrLossAmt holds the net income or loss from partnerships and S corporations combined carried to the summary.

part_iii_entries.rationale: The array of Part III estate/trust rows maps to the repeating EstateAndTrustGroup container; blueprint should decompose each array entry into the individual child elements of that group.

part_iii_net_income_or_loss.rationale: TotEstateAndTrustIncOrLossAmt holds the net income or loss from all estates and trusts combined carried to the summary.

part_iv_entries.rationale: The array of Part IV REMIC rows maps to the repeating REMICGroup container; blueprint should decompose each array entry into the individual child elements of that group.

part_iv_net_income_or_loss.rationale: TotalREMICIncomeAmt holds the net income or loss from all REMIC activities combined carried to the summary.

net_farm_rental_income_or_loss.rationale: NetFarmRentalIncomeOrLossAmt directly maps to the net farm rental income or loss from Form 4835 summary line.

total_supplemental_income_or_loss.rationale: TotalSuppIncomeOrLossAmt is the final summary total of Schedule E (line 41 equivalent) transferred to Form 1040 Schedule 1.
